Minor Girl Missing, Accused Youth From Another District

A minor girl has gone missing from Bhiwani. A youth from Jind has been accused of abducting her. The girl was reported missing in the morning and was due to turn 18 in six months. In a separate incident, an 18-year-old girl was reported abducted in Hapur, and a case has been registered against a youth.
